children: New Delhi, Sept. 25 -- Brokerage firm Ventura Securities has given a Buy call on Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd, with a target price of Rs.165 and a stop-loss at Rs.102. The brokerage's technical view, dated 24 September 2026, describes the stock's short-term outlook as bullish.

According to Ventura Securities, Texmaco Rail began declining from Rs.142.60 in December 2025 and subsequently slipped below its 200-day simple moving average (SMA), hitting a low of Rs.78.05 in March 2026.

The stock later witnessed buying interest and climbed to Rs.130.75 in May 2026. However, resistance at those levels pushed the stock into a consolidation phase, with the price moving between Rs.102.10 and Rs.130.75 from May through August.

Ventura Securities said the stock has recently formed higher bottoms and broken out of a symmetrical triangle, with support from higher trading volumes. The breakout took the stock to Rs.126.65 in September, above the previous swing high of Rs.123.90.

The brokerage expects the stock to move towards Rs.165, while identifying Rs.120-116 and Rs.111-107 as intermediate support zones in case of a pullback. It has been recommended to maintain a stop-loss at Rs.102 for the trade.
Texmaco Rail share price today ended nearly 1% lower on the BSE, the stock touched an intraday low of Rs.124 apiece, and an intraday high of Rs.128.55 per share.
Texmaco Rail shares have rallied around 60% in FY27 so far, while gaining approximately 42% over the past six months.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd reported a 70.7% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs.50.07 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, according to a regulatory filing.
The company had posted a consolidated net profit of Rs.29.33 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Despite the sharp rise in profit, consolidated income declined to Rs.775.20 crore in Q1 FY27, compared with Rs.918.61 crore in the year-ago period.
Texmaco Rail also reported a reduction in total expenses, which fell to Rs.737.09 crore from Rs.881.26 crore a year earlier.

Texmaco Rail & Engineering is a multi-unit engineering and infrastructure company with six manufacturing facilities spread across 6.78 million square feet. Its business portfolio includes the manufacture of rolling stock such as wagons, coaches, locomotive shells and components, as well as hydro-mechanical equipment, steel castings, rail EPC projects, and bridges.
